run_ldm3d_pipeline: run the StableDiffusionLDM3DPipeline to generate RGB and depth images from a text prompt
encode_prompt: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings for the LDM3D pipeline
rescale_noise_cfg: rescale the classifier-free guidance noise predictions to fix overexposure in generated images
retrieve_timesteps: retrieve and configure the diffusion timestep schedule from a scheduler for custom inference steps
encode_image: encode an input image into CLIP image embeddings for IP-Adapter or image conditioning
